lines.en: label iodorm5:
I knock on Io’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Io 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: if utadorm5 == True:
It won’t be my first time being in there since I’ve already come to visit Uta before but...
lines.zh: 这不是我第一次进那间屋子了，我之前就来找过 Uta，不过……

lines.en: Well, I guess it will be interesting hearing Io’s take on the, uhh, {i}condition{/i} of the room.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想听听 Io 对这房间——呃——{i}状况{/i}的说法，应该会挺有意思。

lines.en: else:
I’ve yet to spend any time in there since she and Uta moved in and I’m really curious about what they’ve done with the place.
lines.zh: 她和 Uta 搬进来之后我还没在这儿待过，我很好奇她们把这地方弄成了什么样。

lines.en: If I’m remembering correctly, it’s the first time either of them have lived in a dorm, so I’m sure they’ve put their own personal touches on it in some way already.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这是她们俩第一次住宿舍，所以我敢肯定她们已经用某种方式加上了自己的个人印记。

lines.en: No one answers.
lines.zh: 没人回应。

lines.en: I guess I could have expected as much since this is Io we’re talking about and Uta would have just walked in...
lines.zh: 我大概早该料到——毕竟这可是 Io，换作 Uta 早就直接推门进来了……

lines.en: But I guess there’s always the possibility that she just isn’t at home right now.
lines.zh: 不过我想，也总有她这会儿不在家的可能。

lines.en: Maybe I should call out to her so she knows I’m not some big, bad girl who’s come to...girl-up the place or something.
lines.zh: 也许我该喊一声，好让她知道我不是什么来把这儿「女生化」的高大坏女孩之类的。

lines.en: : Io, it’s me. Are you around right now?
lines.zh: : Io，是我。你在吗？

lines.en: : Oh, shoot.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。

lines.en: : Yeah! Come in, Sensei. I thought you were somebody else.
lines.zh: : 在！请进，Sensei。我还以为是别人呢。

lines.en: Figures.
lines.zh: 果然。

lines.en: scene black
if utadorm5 == False:
I push the door open and notice a massive amount of clutter before it even opens all the way.
lines.zh: 我推开门，门还没完全打开，就看见了堆积如山的杂物。

lines.en: else:
I push the door open to find that it’s in exactly the same state as it was the first time I came here.
lines.zh: 我推开门，发现屋里的状况跟我第一次来时一模一样。

lines.en: I ask myself if it’s really fulfilling to live this way-
lines.zh: 我问自己，这样活着到底有没有成就感——

lines.en: But then I remember that it isn’t fulfilling to live at all and decide to move past it.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起来，活着本身就没有成就感，于是决定翻篇。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm1
: Hey.
: Come to give me a housewarming present or something?
lines.zh: : 是来给我送乔迁礼物的吗？

lines.en: : Will you accept my presence as the...present?
lines.zh: : 我把「我本人」当……礼物，你收吗？

lines.en: : Idunno. Can you do anything cool?
lines.zh: : 不造。你会什么厉害的本事吗？

lines.en: : I made french toast this one time. That’s pretty cool, right?
lines.zh: : 我有一次做了法式吐司。挺厉害的吧？

lines.en: : It’s...normal.
lines.zh: : 那……挺普通的。

lines.en: : If you’re not bringing me a housewarming gift, what are you doing over here?
lines.zh: : 既然你不是来送乔迁礼物的，那你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Just here to see you, I guess. Figured you might be bored or something.
lines.zh: : 大概就是来看看你吧。想着你可能闲得慌之类的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm2
: We’re allowed to hang out in my room?
lines.zh: : 我们可以在我房间里一起玩吗？

lines.en: : Probably not but that’s never stopped me before.
lines.zh: : 大概不行，不过这从来没拦住过我。

lines.en: : Wow. You really do run a strange operation, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。你这套操作可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : I’m either the best or the worst teacher in the world depending on how you look at things.
lines.zh: : 看你怎么想了，我要么是世界上最好的老师，要么是最糟的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm3
: Sorry the place is such a mess but, in my defense, most of this is on Uta.
lines.zh: : 抱歉屋里这么乱，不过说句公道话，大部分得怪 Uta。

lines.en: : I’m just kinda stashing all of my stuff from my aunt’s house here so I can fool around in my spare time.
lines.zh: : 我只是把姑姑家那些东西都搬过来堆在这儿，好让我空闲时间能捣鼓点什么。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure Uta is stashing every single item she’s ever laid her hands on. Pretty different approach if you ask me.
lines.zh: : 而我敢肯定，Uta 是把她碰过的每一样东西都囤在这儿。要我说，这思路可真够不一样的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm4
: But hey, as long as you’re not uncomfortable surrounded by all this junk, I’m more than happy to have you.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，只要你被这堆破烂围着不觉得不舒服，我就非常欢迎你。

lines.en: : Can’t even remember the last time I hung out with anyone who wasn’t a part-time maid.
lines.zh: : 我都记不清上一次跟不是兼职女仆的人一起玩是什么时候了。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll be coming here pretty regularly, so it's best you get used to it.
lines.zh: : 我肯定以后会常来的，所以你最好早点习惯。

lines.en: : There is one thing that’s bothering me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有一件事让我很在意。

lines.en: : Is it the cat on top of the wardrobe?
lines.zh: : 是衣柜顶上那只猫吗？

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : You’re not allergic, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会对猫过敏吧？

lines.en: : I’m not. But I don’t particularly like animals.
lines.zh: : 不过敏。但我特别不喜欢动物。

lines.en: : Ah. Well he’s dead anyway so you don’t have to really worry about either of those things.
lines.zh: : 啊。反正他已经死了，所以这两件事你都不用操心。

lines.en: : Or at least I don’t think you do? I’m not sure how taxidermied animals work for people with allergies.
lines.zh: : 至少我觉得是不用？我不太清楚标本对过敏体质的人是什么效果。

lines.en: : So that was {i}your{/i} cat and not Uta's, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，那是{i}你的{/i}猫，不是 Uta 的？

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm5
: Sir Meowington the Fourth.
lines.zh: : 喵呜顿爵士四世。

lines.en: : What happened to the first three?
lines.zh: : 前三世怎么了？

lines.en: : The same thing that happened to the fourth. They died.
lines.zh: : 跟四世一样。它们死了。

lines.en: : You know, I was expecting a little more information there. But your simplistic way of looking at things has saved us a potentially awkward conversation.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我本来指望能多听点细节。不过你看事情这么简单粗暴，倒也省了我们一场可能很尴尬的对话。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm6
: You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : No sense in going into detail about stuff that’s just gonna bring you down, you know?
lines.zh: : 反正细说那些只会让你心情变差的事也没意义，对吧？

lines.en: : Gotta focus on the good stuff.
lines.zh: : 得把注意力放在好的事情上。

lines.en: : Pretty positive outlook today, Io.
lines.zh: : 你今天心态挺积极的嘛，Io。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 是吧？

lines.en: : Guess I’m in a good mood since my favorite teacher came to visit me.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我最喜欢的老师来看我了，心情好吧。

lines.en: : That’s quite flattering but I’m also your {i}only{/i} teacher, so...
lines.zh: : 这话真让人受用，不过我也是你{i}唯一{/i}的老师，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah but you’d still be my favorite even if I had other ones cause you won’t call on me to answer questions and stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可就算我还有别的老师，你也还会是我最喜欢的——因为你不会点我起来回答问题什么的。

lines.en: : I’d need to give out questions in order to do that in the first place, so yeah. You don’t have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 要那样我首先得布置问题才行，所以是啊。这点你不用担心。

lines.en: scene black
Io moves a few steps to the side and takes a seat on an old-looking computer chair.
lines.zh: Io 往旁边挪了几步，在一张看起来很旧的电脑椅上坐下。

lines.en: She also grabs a boxcutter off of her desk and begins to twirl it around with her fingers.
lines.zh: 她还从桌上抄起一把美工刀，开始用手指转着玩。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm7
: So, now what? Wanna play a game or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来干嘛？想玩个游戏什么的吗？

lines.en: : Saying that while twirling a boxcutter doesn’t exactly make me want to play anything you might be into.
lines.zh: : 你一边转着美工刀一边说这话，实在让我提不起兴趣玩你喜欢的任何东西。

lines.en: : Oh, this thing? It’s kinda dull. You don’t have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个？它挺钝的。你不用担心。

lines.en: : It looks incredibly sharp.
lines.zh: : 它看起来锋利得要命。

lines.en: : Scared of sharp stuff, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 怕尖锐的东西？

lines.en: : I want to throw it out there that that is a perfectly reasonable thing to be afraid of.
lines.zh: : 我想说一句，怕那个是完全合理的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm8
: Relax. It’s just a tool. I’ve got tons of stuff way more dangerous than this lying around the room.
lines.zh: : 放松点。这只是个工具。我屋里还堆着一堆比这危险得多的东西呢。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm9
: As long as you watch your step and make sure the area is clear before you sit down, you’re totally safe.
lines.zh: : 只要你注意脚下、坐下前确认周围没东西，你就绝对安全。

lines.en: : I stepped on a nail once at my aunt’s place and you wouldn’t believe how-
lines.zh: : 我有一次在姑姑家踩到钉子，你都想象不出有多——

lines.en: : Whatever you think I wouldn’t believe, I can probably assure you I would.
lines.zh: : 不管你觉得我有多想象不出，我大概都能向你保证我想象得出。

lines.en: : What, I can’t even tell my nail story?
lines.zh: : 什么嘛，我连钉子的故事都不能讲？

lines.en: : You can not.
lines.zh: : 就是不能。

lines.en: : Instead, why not tell me more about this infatuation with tools? Like, why a boxcutter?
lines.zh: : 不如换个话题，跟我说说你对工具的这份痴迷？比如，为什么是美工刀？

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm10
: We talked about my hobbies for like two hours at the bathhouse the other day. I like making things, remember?
lines.zh: : 前两天在澡堂我们聊我的爱好聊了差不多两个小时啊。我喜欢做东西，记得吗？

lines.en: : The boxcutter is just for cutting boxes, though.
lines.zh: : 不过美工刀就是用来切纸箱的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm9
: Unless you make me mad. Then it will be for cutting Senseis.
lines.zh: : 除非你惹我生气。那它就用来切 Sensei 了。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm11
: Um...That was a joke.
lines.zh: : 呃……那是开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t actually hurt you, you know.
lines.zh: : 我不会真的伤害你的，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’m surprisingly non-confrontational for someone always talking down on other people.
lines.zh: : 对一个总在贬低别人的人来说，我意外地不爱跟人起冲突。

lines.en: : I’d probably just stop talking to you or...punch the wall or something if you ever made me that mad.
lines.zh: : 要是你真把我惹到那个份上，我大概就只是不再理你，或者……去捶墙什么的。

lines.en: : Can you at least put the boxcutter down, Io?
lines.zh: : 那你至少能把美工刀放下吗，Io？

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm12
: No. I need something to fidget with or I'll start getting uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 不行。我得手里有点东西摆弄，不然我会开始不自在。

lines.en: : Its the first time I've ever had a boy in my room. Please don't hold my discomfort against me.
lines.zh: : 这是我第一次让男生进我房间。别把我的不自在怪到我头上。

lines.en: Io begins quickly sliding the blade up and down with the little knob thing on the handle.
lines.zh: Io 开始用刀柄上那个小疙瘩飞快地把刀片推上推下。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s a special name for it but I have no idea what it's called so you’re going to have to deal with “knob thing” until I find out.
lines.zh: 我肯定它有个专门的名字，但我完全不知道叫什么，所以在查到之前，你只能将就着听我说「小疙瘩」了。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm13
: So, Sensei, is there anything you want me to try making you?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei，有什么你想让我试着做给你的吗？

lines.en: : I just finished that second wardrobe a little while ago and I’m kinda out of big projects for now.
lines.zh: : 我前阵子刚做完第二个衣柜，眼下暂时没有大件项目了。

lines.en: : Second wardrobe? Like, the one in this room?
lines.zh: : 第二个衣柜？你是指这屋里那个？

lines.en: : Obviously. What other wardrobe would I be talking about?
lines.zh: : 不然呢。我还能说哪个衣柜？

lines.en: : You made those? They look professional.
lines.zh: : 那些是你做的？看着跟专业做的一样。

lines.en: : The one on the right has one leg that’s a little shorter than the others so it would never actually be able to ship or anything, but thanks.
lines.zh: : 右边那个有条腿比其他的短一点，所以它永远没法真的出厂发货什么的，不过谢谢。

lines.en: : It’s really nice making stuff like that- stuff that can be used immediately.
lines.zh: : 做这种东西感觉真好——那种立刻就能用上的东西。

lines.en: : Sometimes, you’ll go out of your way to make something for somebody and they’ll act like they love it, but never actually use or find a use for it.
lines.zh: : 有时候你特意为某人做了个东西，他们表现得好像很喜欢，却从来不会真的去用、或者给它找个用处。

lines.en: : It really sucks when stuff like that happens.
lines.zh: : 碰上这种事真的很难受。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm14
: So I only make things that I know other people need or that I can use myself now.
lines.zh: : 所以我现在只做我知道别人需要的东西，或者我自己用得上的东西。

lines.en: : Well, the second I need a carpenter, I know who to come to.
lines.zh: : 行，等我需要木匠那天，我知道该找谁了。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm13
: Heheh~ Part carpenter, part floor scrubber.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 半个木匠，半个擦地工。

lines.en: : Not exactly a glamorous life I’m leading, is it?
lines.zh: : 我这日子过得可算不上光鲜，是吧？

lines.en: : No, but it fits you.
lines.zh: : 是，但很适合你。

lines.en: : I know that's probably supposed to be a compliment but it makes me feel kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 我知道这大概是句好话，可它让我觉得有点恶心。

lines.en: : I just mean that I admire how you do the things you want to do without letting societal norms get in your way.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我挺佩服你能做自己想做的事，不让社会规范碍你的事。

lines.en: : I think it’s closer to me just avoiding ever figuring out what those societal norms are, but yeah. I’m gonna do what I want to do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更接近于我压根就没去搞明白那些社会规范是什么，不过是啊。我想干什么就干什么。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm15
: Which is why I’m more than happy to take up your time when there are plenty of other girls hoping you’ll knock on {i}their{/i} doors instead of mine.
lines.zh: : 所以，明明有一堆别的女生盼着你去敲{i}她们{/i}的门、而不是我的，我却非常乐意占用你的时间。

lines.en: : I win, even if it’s only for tonight.
lines.zh: : 我赢了，哪怕只赢了今晚。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm14
: So, if there’s anything I can make to show you that I’m worth your time, feel free to let me know.
lines.zh: : 所以，如果有什么我能做出来、向你证明我值得你花时间的东西，尽管开口。

lines.en: : If not, I’ll probably just wind up making a third wardrobe and the room will look like even more of a trainwreck.
lines.zh: : 不然的话，我大概就会去做第三个衣柜，然后这屋子会看起来更像火车事故现场。

lines.en: : It {i}would{/i} be nice having somewhere to put {i}my{/i} clothes, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，能有个地方放{i}我的{/i}衣服{i}也{/i}挺好的。

lines.en: Something Io said jumped out at me there.
lines.zh: Io 说的某句话在这里突然引起了我的注意。

lines.en: “To show you that I’m worth your time,” is a phrase that, when isolated, looks remarkably self-deprecating.
lines.zh: 「向你证明我值得你花时间」这句话，单拎出来看，显得格外自贬。

lines.en: And when paired with her tendencies to call herself trash or whatever it is she’s spouted before, it makes sense.
lines.zh: 再配上她以前动不动就说自己是垃圾之类的毛病，就说得通了。

lines.en: But the issue with dissecting small parts of dialogue like that and using them to assign attributes to people is that sometimes people deviate.
lines.zh: 但像这样把对话的片段拆开来、据此给人贴标签，问题在于——人有时候是会偏离的。

lines.en: Maybe her offer to create something for me is less self-deprecation and more just the desire to please?
lines.zh: 也许她说要为我做点什么，与其说是自贬，不如说只是想讨我欢心？

lines.en: I should ask her.
lines.zh: 我应该问问她。

lines.en: : Do you really think you’re not worth my time?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得自己不值得我花时间吗？

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm16
: Hm? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你什么意思？

lines.en: : You offered to make me something to show me that you're worth it. What did you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你说要做个东西给我，好向我证明你值得。你那是什么意思？

lines.en: : Hey. Speaking unfiltered thoughts is my job. You’re supposed to be the sponge.
lines.zh: : 嘿。把没过滤的想法说出来是我的活儿。你该当那块海绵。

lines.en: : Sometimes, you’ve gotta wring the sponge out to make room for more liquid.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你得把海绵拧干，好腾出地方装更多液体。

lines.en: : This is a really weird analogy. I’m getting uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 这比喻真够怪的。我开始不自在了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounded better in my head.
lines.zh: : 是啊，在我脑子里听着比说出来好。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to figure out more about you in the least intrusive way possible, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我只是想用尽可能不打扰你的方式，多了解你一点吧。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm17
: That’s a good strategy.
lines.zh: : 这策略不错。

lines.en: : To clarify, I {i}can’t{/i} exactly think I’m not worth your time because I don’t quite know what your time is worth.
lines.zh: : 先说明白，我{i}没法{/i}真的觉得自己不值得你花时间，因为我也不太清楚你的时间值多少。

lines.en: : But Henry David Thoreau once said-
lines.zh: : 但 Henry David Thoreau 说过——

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm18
: {i}Be not simply good; be good for something.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不要只是做个好人，要做个有用的人。{/i}

lines.en: : And so it’s important that we all make some sort of impact in the lives of others.
lines.zh: : 所以说，我们每个人都得在别人的人生里留下某种影响，这很重要。

lines.en: : If I can create something that changes your life, or even your daily ritual, I will be able to make a difference...albeit a relatively minuscule one.
lines.zh: : 如果我能做出什么东西，改变你的人生、哪怕只是改变你的日常习惯，那我就能带来一点不同……尽管是相当微小的一点。

lines.en: : I’ll move one step closer to “good for something” rather than just a slowly dying flesh-compound who spends her nights picking splinters out of her fingertips.
lines.zh: : 这样我就离「有用的人」近了一步，而不只是个夜里忙着挑指尖木刺的、正在慢慢死去的肉块。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm19
: You feel me?
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思吗？

lines.en: : I feel like I understand you less and more at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己同时更懂你、也更不懂你了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Let me show you something else and probably confuse you even more, then.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 那我再给你看个东西，大概会把你弄得更糊涂。

lines.en: scene black
Io gets off the chair and walks over to a small shelf full of miscellaneous objects near the door.
lines.zh: Io 从椅子上下来，走到门边一个摆满杂物的小架子前。

lines.en: She moves aside a few books, knocking what sounds like loose change onto the floor, before returning and brandishing a strange looking figure before me.
lines.zh: 她把几本书挪开，听声音像是把零钱碰掉到了地上，然后回来，在我面前扬起一个样子奇怪的小人。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm20
: Did you have any toys you played with as a kid, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你小时候有什么玩具吗？

lines.en: : Do you even remember things from back then?
lines.zh: : 你还记得那时候的事吗？

lines.en: : You don’t, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不记得了，对吧？

lines.en: : You know, many popular psychologists say that memory loss can be the result of repeated trauma.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，很多知名心理学家都说，记忆缺失可能是反复创伤的结果。

lines.en: : Of course, this isn’t me insinuating that that's what’s going on for you, but it {i}is{/i} a thing that happens.
lines.zh: : 当然，我不是在暗示你就是这种情况，但这种事{i}确实{/i}会发生。

lines.en: : Without getting more off the rails, the point I’m trying to land at is that the first few years of your life are irrefutably the most important.
lines.zh: : 不继续跑题了，我想说的是：人生最初那几年，无可辩驳是最重要的。

lines.en: : A lot of kids these days would look at something like this little guy and think, “What am I supposed to do with it?”
lines.zh: : 现在有很多小孩看到这个小家伙之类的东西，会想：「我该拿它干什么？」

lines.en: : “How can I have fun with this?”
lines.zh: : 「我怎么能靠它玩得开心？」

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm21
: But then, there are a handful of kids without anything.
lines.zh: : 但也有那么一些孩子，什么都没有。

lines.en: : A handful of kids who would take something like this in their tiny, little hands and give it a name.
lines.zh: : 那么一些孩子，会把这样的东西捧进小小的手心里，给它起个名字。

lines.en: : Give it value.
lines.zh: : 赋予它价值。

lines.en: : Were you one of those k-
lines.zh: : 你也是他们中的——

lines.en: : I’m one of them now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我现在是他们中的一员了，Sensei。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm20
: This isn’t something I leaned on when I was growing up or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 这不是我小时候依赖过的东西之类的。

lines.en: : It’s something I {i}made{/i}.
lines.zh: : 是我{i}做出来{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : Something that {i}could{/i} be that much-needed solace for someone in dire straits.
lines.zh: : 某个{i}能{/i}让身处绝境的人得到急需慰藉的东西。

lines.en: : But instead of being in anyone else’s hands, it’s collecting dust on a shelf in my room alongside several others just like it.
lines.zh: : 可它没有落到任何人手里，而是和我房间里另外几个一模一样的家伙一起，在架子上积灰。

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 可是为什么呢？

lines.en: : Why not give it away if you think it can help someone?
lines.zh: : 既然你觉得它能帮到别人，为什么不送出去？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm22
: Because I’m all talk.
lines.zh: : 因为我只会说。

lines.en: : Because it’s easy for me to start things but near impossible for me to finish them.
lines.zh: : 因为对我来说，开始一件事很容易，完成却几乎不可能。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm23
: I’m bad at seeing things through to the end.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长把事情做到最后。

lines.en: : I couldn’t even finish my introduction in class the right way.
lines.zh: : 我连课上的自我介绍都没能好好说完。

lines.en: : And yeah, I’m still impressionable...but the only impressions I’ve gotten the last few years are that I need to hurry up and find my place in the world.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我还是很容易受影响……可这几年我得到的唯一印象就是：我得赶紧在世界上找到自己的位置。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm24
: Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Maybe I'm just struggling to give this little guy away because he reminds me of myself?
lines.zh: : 也许我舍不得把这个小家伙送出去，就是因为他让我想起了我自己？

lines.en: : Collecting dust somewhere and too empty to actually make anyone happy.
lines.zh: : 在某个地方积灰，空虚到根本没法让任何人幸福。

lines.en: : The only difference is that {i}I{/i} actually have a name.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是，{i}我{/i}是有个名字的。

lines.en: : And that he’s made out of wood.
lines.zh: : 还有，他是木头做的。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm25
: Heh...Yeah. I guess there’s more than just one key difference if you want to state the obvious.
lines.zh: : 呵……是啊。如果你想说点明摆着的事，我想关键区别还不止一个。

lines.en: : I’m a lot taller than him too. And a little better at talking to people.
lines.zh: : 我还比他高很多。而且跟人说话也比他强一点。

lines.en: : Jokes aside, if you need something or someone to lean on, I’m sure both Uta and myself would be viable candidates.
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，如果你需要什么东西或什么人依靠，我敢肯定 Uta 和我都是合适的人选。

lines.en: : I also wouldn’t mind helping you find a use for your apparent collection of unnamed wooden robots.
lines.zh: : 我也不介意帮你给你那堆显然是无名的木质机器人找个用处。

lines.en: : I’ve got the numbers for two nearby orphanages saved in my phone if you want them.
lines.zh: : 我手机里存了附近两家孤儿院的号码，你要的话给你。

lines.en: : I figured I could donate a lot of the stuff I make to charities but then I look at it all and second-guess myself.
lines.zh: : 我本来想着能把自己做的很多东西捐给慈善机构，可一看到这些东西，我就开始自我怀疑。

lines.en: : Funny, huh?
lines.zh: : 很好笑吧？

lines.en: : I went as far as mentioning that things like this could save lives or whatever but I don’t even believe it myself.
lines.zh: : 我甚至都说到了「这种东西能救命」什么的，可我自己都不信。

lines.en: : They’re just...wooden blocks at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 说到底，它们就只是……几块木头。

lines.en: : You prepared {i}that{/i} much and still didn’t finish the job? Just donate them, Io.
lines.zh: : 你都准备到{i}这一步{/i}了，还是没把事情做完？直接捐了就是了，Io。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm26
: I’ve got a problem, okay?
lines.zh: : 我就是有毛病，行吧？

lines.en: : I want to make a difference but I’m too scared to actually do it.
lines.zh: : 我想带来改变，可我又太害怕，不敢真的去做。

lines.en: : Well, at least you understand your fatal flaw. That’s more than most people can say.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少你明白自己的致命缺陷。这已经比大多数人都强了。

lines.en: scene iofirstdorm27
: Fatal flaw, huh?
lines.zh: : 致命缺陷，是吗？

lines.en: : If only it were just one.
lines.zh: : 要是只有一个就好了。

lines.en: scene black
Io shows me a few other toys she’s made for the purpose of making other people happy and I’m extremely impressed by the level of detail in some of them.
lines.zh: Io 又给我看了几个她为了让别人开心而做的玩具，其中一些的细节之讲究让我非常惊讶。

lines.en: She's right about one thing, at the very least.
lines.zh: 至少有一件事她没说错。

lines.en: Objects like this aren’t really appreciated by kids anymore.
lines.zh: 像这样的东西，现在已经不太被小孩子们看在眼里了。

lines.en: Which is extremely depressing given how much thought I know Io has put into making them.
lines.zh: 想想我知道 Io 在做它们时花了多少心思，这就格外让人沮丧。

lines.en: But they serve no purpose collecting dust in an overly-cluttered dorm room.
lines.zh: 可它们在堆得满满当当的宿舍房间里积灰，发挥不了任何作用。

lines.en: They’d be better anywhere else-
lines.zh: 它们待在任何别的地方都会更好——

lines.en: Just like many of us.
lines.zh: 就像我们许多人一样。

lines.en: The only issue is getting them there.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是怎么把它们送到那儿。

lines.en: Io starts dozing off an hour or two later and I decide to leave and let her get her rest.
lines.zh: 一两个小时后 Io 开始打瞌睡，我决定离开，让她好好休息。

lines.en: She thanks me a bunch of times for “putting up with her” and, once again, displays another weakness of hers.
lines.zh: 她一遍又一遍地谢我「受得了她」，又一次露出了她的另一个弱点。

lines.en: I think I’m beginning to understand just how many of those there may be.
lines.zh: 我想我开始明白，这样的弱点到底可能有多少个。

lines.en: At the same time, though, it’s admirable how much effort she’s putting into living up to her ideals.
lines.zh: 可与此同时，她为不辜负自己的理想所付出的努力，又让人佩服。

lines.en: It’s rare to find someone so strong and weak at the same time.
lines.zh: 同时如此强大又如此脆弱的人，实在少见。

lines.en: I just hope that both extremes wind up cancelling each other out so that she, one day, finds a trace of normalcy in this shithole we call life.
lines.zh: 我只希望这两个极端最终能相互抵消，让她有朝一日能在这个我们称之为「人生」的狗屁地方里，找到一丝正常。
